integrity: Algebraic proof plus exact rational verifier; no claim of external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Three binary information symbols, fully symmetric support multiplicities, independent sampling with replacement, noiseless iterative peeling only; neither nonbinary nor nonsymmetric nor ideal linear decoding is covered. A length-100 witness is not proven globally optimal. Unindexed finite-length literature may overlap.
title: Finite-three-source peeling law and necessity of degree-three packets
